test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was the author of the book ‘Tarikh-i-Firoz Shahi’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ziauddin Barani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ziauddin Barani **was the author of the book **‘Tarikh-i-Firoz Shahi’.**
 
• **The Tarikh-i Firoz Shahi **stands as a remarkable example of **Indo-Persian historiography** from the Sultanate era in India.
 
• Completed in **1357 CE**, it was dedicated to the reigning monarch of the time.
 
• Ziauddin Barani, an Indian Muslim political thinker** during the reigns of Muhammad bin Tughlaq and Firuz Shah**, was renowned for his authorship of the Tarikh-i-Firoz Shahi (also known as Tarikh-i-Firuz Shahi).
 
• This historical work provides insights into medieval India, spanning from the rule of Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq to the initial years of Firuz Shah Tughluq's reign.
 
• Barani's Fatwa-i-Jahandari, while promoting a hierarchy among Muslim communities in the Indian subcontinent, was not strictly based on race or caste.
 
• It drew inspiration from the Sassanid Iran model, which emphasized aristocracy through birth.
 
• This concept, according to some scholars, aligned with the evolving Islamic thought of the time, as evident in the works of contemporaries like Ibn Khaldun.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Minhaj-us-Siraj** was a Persian historian born in the Ghurid region during the 13th century. In 1227, he migrated to Ucch and later settled in Delhi.
 
• **Abu Fazl **was an Indian writer, historian, and statesman who held the position of grand vizier in the Mughal Empire from his appointment in 1579 until his passing in 1602.
 
• **Syedna Mohammed Badruddin **served as the 46th Da'i al-Mutlaq of the Dawoodi Bohra community. He succeeded Syedna Tayyeb Zainuddin as the religious leader.
